title: Live loadgen reusable payload cache harness
purpose: Remove avoidable loadgen CPU and remote-copy churn from reset-before-each-run live benchmarks by supporting deterministic writer seeds, stable remote cache dirs, cached loadgen binaries/writer shards, and reusable prebuilt signed JSON-RPC payload bodies.
notes: Payload caching is intentionally opt-in and limited to non-strict batched place-order runs, matching the live green ladder shape.
Cached payloads are safe only after a chain reset plus deterministic reseed; reusing them twice inside the same chain state creates duplicate/stale nonces.
The wrapper defaults cached payload TTL to 315360000000 ms when LOADTEST_PAYLOAD_CACHE=1 so cached signed intents survive reuse across later reset/replay runs.
This is not a TPS result. The next live ladder must measure whether cached payloads lift delivered RPS or only reduce runner CPU variance.
example: LOADTEST_WRITER_SEED_TAG=270 LOADTEST_REMOTE_CACHE_DIR=/var/tmp/kombat-loadgen-cache LOADTEST_PAYLOAD_CACHE=1 LOADTEST_EXTERNAL_RUNNER_HOSTS='root@203.0.113.10 root@203.0.113.12 root@203.0.113.11 root@203.0.113.13' bash chain/scripts/loadtest_live_network_multi_ingress.sh /tmp/and-live-testnet 32 40000 60
